data.body: **[P2] Do not use hook order as proof that the parent preceded the child.** A context's success checkpoint is queued before its `onOperationEnd`, so a retained callback that already completed can first appear in that checkpoint response after this ID is recorded. It is then incorrectly reparented to `Workflow` even though its backend end precedes the parent. Track parent end metadata and detach only when the child actually completed later; add a test where the callback update arrives with the parent's terminal checkpoint response.
